scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a wet two-lane road while a white car overtakes from the left and a dark SUV follows behind, with oncoming traffic visible ahead.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane on a wet road.

adversarials.behavior: The white car overtakes the ego vehicle from the left lane, moves ahead, and then returns to the ego lane in front of the ego vehicle.
The dark SUV follows behind the overtaking white car and continues traveling in the same direction.
The silver car travels straight ahead in the opposite direction toward the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a two-lane rural road with one lane in each direction, with a white car initially to the left and slightly behind, a dark SUV further behind, and a silver oncoming car ahead in the opposite lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario occurs on a wet road surface requiring appropriate speed and distance management; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has passed the overtaking maneuver and continues along the road.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right side of the road, visible ahead of the ego vehicle.
